articles.title: RAG Retrieval Lost 40 Points When Distracting Passages Grew to 2.68M
articles.reason: This article provides concrete, reproducible evaluation of RAG retrieval performance at scale, highlighting pitfalls in retrieval quality that directly impact enterprise RAG deployments.

articles.title: Keyword Search Tied an 8B Embedding Model at Picking Agent Tools
articles.reason: Demonstrates that traditional keyword search (BM25) can match or outperform large embedding models for agent tool selection, with significant speed and cost advantages—directly relevant for optimizing RAG and agentic workflows in enterprise settings.
articles.summary: This article benchmarks BM25 keyword search against an 8B parameter embedding model (BGE-large) for selecting tools in agentic workflows, showing BM25 is up to 40x faster on CPU and equally accurate when using full tool documentation. The findings suggest that simpler, cheaper retrieval methods can be highly effective for tool selection in multi-agent pipelines. This has direct implications for designing efficient, cost-effective RAG and agent orchestration systems in production environments.
actionable_insights: Benchmark BM25 or other keyword search methods against embedding models in your current agent tool selection pipelines to assess potential speed and cost gains.
Consider using full tool documentation as retrieval context to maximize accuracy in tool selection tasks.
Re-evaluate the necessity of large embedding models for certain retrieval tasks, especially where latency and compute cost are critical.
